title: VeloGraphX: Adaptive Exact Analytics for Evolving Graphs
description: Submission-era frozen research artifact for VeloGraphX, a C++20 system that exposes exact localized repair and full recomputation as selectable physical execution strategies over a common mutable graph substrate. The archive includes source, correctness tests, benchmark contracts, publication evidence registries, and reproducibility instructions. Quantitative claims remain scoped to the retained evidence and timing contracts.
